name: Purnululu National Park
description: In the remote East Kimberley of Western Australia, about 300 km south of Kununurra, Purnululu National Park is home to the Bungle Bungle Range. Its beehive-shaped sandstone domes rise up to 250 metres above the dry grasslands. Each dome is striped orange and black, the black bands being thin layers of cyanobacteria that shield the soft rock, which has been eroding for some 20 million years.
